description: Construction of a State-of-the-Art Building for the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-09-15, for the implementation of the project to construct a State-of-the-Art Building for the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Jaffna. Accordingly, bids have been invited through the national competitive procurement method to select a suitable contractor for the implementation of the said project. Eight (08) bids have been received for the same.  Based on the recommendation submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of the said bids the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education, to award the said contract to M/s Central Engineering Services (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs. 2,025.73 million (excluding Value Added Tax), was approved by the Cabinet.
